Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Keeper of Mortality
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly NIGHTHAUNT unit within 3" of this MANIFESTATION to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following effects:
• Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for target for the rest of the turn.
• Heal (3) the target.

abilities.name: Spell-eaters
abilities.description: Effect: If a friendly NIGHTHAUNT unit wholly within 12" of this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, this unit can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had WIZARD (1). Add 1 to the unbinding roll for that ability. If the spell is unbound, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.
abilities.condition: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability

abilities.name: Awful Refashioning
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly Nexus of Grief, then pick up to 3 friendly NIGHTHAUNT units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be a target of this ability more than once per phase.

Effect: For each target:
• If the target is damaged, Heal (D3) the target.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to D3.

abilities.name: Hungry Crypts
abilities.description: Effect: Remove this terrain feature from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield within 3" of a friendly NIGHTHAUNT unit, more than 3" from all objectives and enemy units, more than 1" from all terrain features and more than 12" from all other friendly Nexuses of Grief.

abilities.name: Screams of the Penitent
abilities.description: Effect: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are within 3" of this terrain feature.

abilities.name: Light A Pyre
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is contesting an objective, pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Add a number equal to the roll to this unit’s control score for the rest of the turn.
abilities.condition: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

abilities.name: Soul Reaper
abilities.description: Effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this MANIFESTATION's Almighty Reap if it charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Drawn to War
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY HEROES have WARD (4+) while they are wholly within this unit’s combat range.

abilities.name: Siphon Souls
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a model from a friendly or enemy unit is slain within 12" of this MANIFESTATION, give this MANIFESTATION a soul point, to a maximum of 6.

abilities.name: Soul Eruption
abilities.description:
Declare: If this MANIFESTATION has 6 soul points, pick any number of enemy units within 6" of this MANIFESTATION to be the targets.

Effect: Roll 6 dice for each target. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, reset this MANIFESTATION's soul points to 0.

abilities.name: One Stop, No Return
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an objective you do not control to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, while enemy units are contesting the target objective, attacks made by those units cannot score critical hits while this unit is also contesting it (treat them as regular hits instead).

abilities.name: Spectral Attendants
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn:

Noble Blade: This unit's melee weapons, including Companion weapons, have Crit (Mortal) instead of Crit (Auto-wound).

Unholy Grail: Each time a friendly NIGHTHAUNT unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you receive 3 additional rally points.

Tome of Undead Lore: This unit has WIZARD (1).

abilities.name: Spectral Carriage
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.name: Terrifying Spectres
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a friendly NIGHTHAUNT HERO in combat with the enemy target to be the friendly target.

Effect: You can spend 1 rage dice. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent’s fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

For the rest of the turn:
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by the enemy target that do not target this unit.
• Ignore positive modifiers to hit rolls for the enemy target’s attacks.
• If you picked a friendly target, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of its melee weapons for attacks that target the enemy target.
